name: yasun-studio-e2e
description: Browser E2E, rich-lesson and UI-quality audits against a running stack (uses the system Chrome).

scripts.reset-limits: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec -T redis sh -c "redis-cli --scan --pattern 'ratelimit:*' | xargs -r redis-cli del" > /dev/null
scripts.all: npm run flow && npm run rich && npm run audit
